objective: Measure whether a candidate extractor can turn authorized prose into provenance-bearing narrative observations without inventing chronology, causality, knowledge, perspective, narrative function, or closure.

false_certainty.definition: A prediction absent from gold or forbidden by a protected ambiguity with confidence at or above the threshold.
false_certainty.rule: False certainty is a first-class failure. Aggregate F1 cannot hide it.

ambiguity_rule: When gold marks a case as intentionally ambiguous, a single ASSERTED interpretation is a premature resolution unless the gold explicitly permits it.

forbidden: bulk copyrighted book or article bodies
source_policy.split_rule: Hold out entire source works or authors where practical; do not leak adjacent passages from one work across tune/test boundaries.

stress_slices: same event retold from multiple anchors
surface-style attractiveness conflicting with story function
admission_rule: A candidate extractor may emit candidate observations only. Canonical narrative state remains downstream of provenance, validation, ambiguity, calibration, preservation, and explicit authority gates.
